name: hospital-management-system
description: Hospital Management System (HMS) monorepo workspace root. Orchestrates the React frontend and the Node.js/Express backend microservices and provides shared developer tooling. This is a private npm workspace root and intentionally contains NO application/runtime dependencies (those live in each frontend/backend workspace).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace frontend --if-present" "npm run dev --workspaces --if-present"
